question.text: How many Bank of England MPC members will vote to raise Bank Rate at the December 17, 2026 meeting?
question.resolution_criteria: This question resolves as the number of Bank of England Monetary Policy Committee members voting to raise the Bank Rate at the [December](https://www.bankofengland.co.uk/monetary-policy-summary-and-minutes/2026/december-2026) meeting.
question.fine_print: If for any reason the meeting does not take place, the question resolves as <1.

research:
I'm writing up the findings now. The key sources are the November minutes, the Reuters poll, Pill's FT interview and the Lombardelli coverage.

## 1. Resolution source
- The December 2026 Monetary Policy Summary page will publish the vote on 2026-12-17. It is not out yet. [BoE](https://www.bankofengland.co.uk/monetary-policy-summary-and-minutes/2026/december-2026)
- 2026-11-05 (latest decision): the MPC raised Bank Rate from 3.75% to 4.00%. All 9 members voted to raise. Eight (Bailey, Breeden, Dhingra, Greene, Lombardelli, Pill, Ramsden, Taylor) voted for +25bp and Mann voted for +50bp. So the November meeting would have counted as 9 under this question, if the count includes a vote for a bigger rise. The statement said policy is "not on a pre-set path." [BoE Nov 2026](https://www.bankofengland.co.uk/monetary-policy-summary-and-minutes/2026/november-2026)

## 2. Current status
- Nothing settles the question yet. How members leaned in the November minutes:
  - Leaning towards another rise: Pill ("more tightening, including in the near term"), Lombardelli ("likely case for another near-term rise"), Greene (expects more hikes, timing open), Mann (wanted more already).
  - Conditional: Bailey and Breeden (depends on energy and inflation news).
  - Reluctant: Taylor ("not the start of a hiking cycle") and Dhingra (wants evidence first).
  - I found no stated December view for Ramsden. [BoE](https://www.bankofengland.co.uk/monetary-policy-summary-and-minutes/2026/november-2026)

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-11-14: The FT, as reported by AOL, says Pill signalled he will vote for another 25bp rise in December and expects more rises in 2027. He called market pricing of about 90bp of tightening by end-2027 "not outrageous." [AOL/FT](https://www.aol.com/articles/boe-likely-raise-rates-further-065906000.html)
- 2026-11-13: Reuters poll, taken 11 to 13 November. 64 of 65 economists expect a hold at 4.00% in December, with the median next hike in February. Most see a peak of 4.25%, and seven see no further rise. Reuters also says futures "almost fully price" a December hike. September CPI was 3.5% and Q3 GDP grew 0.7%. Energy bills are expected to rise about 20% in January. [Reuters via 933thedrive](https://www.933thedrive.com/2026/11/13/bank-of-england-to-wait-until-february-to-next-raise-rates-say-economists-reuters-poll/)
- 2026-11-12: OIS pricing implied about a 75% chance of a 25bp rise in December, according to an aggregator summary that I could not check directly. [Yahoo](https://finance.yahoo.com/economy/policy/articles/uk-interest-rates-fall-2026-160348987.html)
- 2026-11-10/11: Lombardelli said the risks to inflation are "to the upside" and that she "wouldn't rule December in or out." December pricing rose from about 13bp to about 17bp. The 10-year gilt yield went above 5.20%. [Pound Sterling Live](https://www.poundsterlinglive.com/economics/23868-bank-of-england-lombardelli-december-rate-rise-labour-market-fed), [ForexTraders](https://forextraders.com/forex-news/bank-of-englands-lombardelli-wont-rule-out-december-rate-hike/)
- 2026-11-05: Bailey said the November rise should not be seen as the first of an inevitable sequence, and more hikes depend on the Middle East conflict. One economist called December a coin flip that depends on oil and gas prices. [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/05/interest-rates-inflation-uk.html)
- Background: oil has been above $100 since July, and the BoE warns inflation could approach 5% in 2027. [MPA](https://www.mpamag.com/uk/mortgage-industry/market-trends/bank-of-england-urged-to-raise-base-rate-to-5-as-inflation-set-to-miss-target-until-2030/597029)

## 4. Base rates
These figures are from memory, not checked against the BoE in this session. Each figure counts every vote for any rise.
- Holds during or around a hiking cycle still drew hike votes:
  - Nov 2021: 7-2 hold, so 2 voted to raise
  - Sep 2023: 5-4 hold, so 4
  - Nov 2023: 6-3 hold, so 3
  - Dec 2023: 6-3 hold, so 3
  - Feb 2024: 2 voted to raise
- Meetings that raised rates:
  - Dec 2021: 8 voted to raise
  - Feb to Nov 2022: usually 8 or 9
  - Dec 2022 to Aug 2023: 7 (Dhingra and Tenreyro dissented for a hold)
- Pattern: the result tends to be one of two clusters. A rise usually means 6 to 9 votes to raise. A hold usually means 2 to 4, and with Mann's hawkishness a hold would almost certainly include at least 1 or 2 (Mann, Pill).
- In the current committee, Taylor and Dhingra are the likeliest to dissent against a rise. Mann, Pill, Lombardelli and Greene are the likeliest to vote to raise even if the majority holds.
- This is not a seasonal question.

## 5. Other forecasts
- Polymarket, "Bank of England decision in December?" (fetched 2026-11-14): 25bp increase 72.5%, no change 26.5%, 50bp or more increase 0.15%, cuts about 0.2%. This is the matching market, but it prices the decision, not the vote count.
- Polymarket, February 2027: 25bp increase 67.5%. March 2027: no change 63%.
- Market pricing: OIS was about 17bp (about 70%) as of 2026-11-11, and Reuters described it as "almost fully priced" on 2026-11-13.
- Economists: 64 of 65 expect a hold (Reuters poll, 2026-11-13). That contrasts sharply with market pricing, and the poll mostly came before Pill's FT interview.
- Kalshi: the gold, silver and GBP/USD contracts are only timed to the BoE decision and are not relevant. I found no Kalshi, Manifold or Metaculus market on the BoE vote count.

## 6. Upcoming events before 2026-12-17
- 2026-11-18: October CPI. [Reuters poll](https://www.933thedrive.com/2026/11/13/bank-of-england-to-wait-until-february-to-next-raise-rates-say-economists-reuters-poll/)
- Mid-November and mid-December: labour market and wage data. I did not confirm exact dates.
- Around 2026-12-16: November CPI, one day before the decision. Some economists say this will decide their call.
- Throughout: oil and gas prices and the Iran conflict, named by Bailey and Breeden as the swing factor.
- More MPC speeches are likely before the pre-meeting quiet period, especially from Bailey, Breeden, Ramsden, Greene and Taylor. I found no December-specific remarks from them yet.
- The ECB's December decision falls the same day, with a hike priced at about 96% on Polymarket.

Sources: [BoE Nov 2026](https://www.bankofengland.co.uk/monetary-policy-summary-and-minutes/2026/november-2026), [AOL/FT](https://www.aol.com/articles/boe-likely-raise-rates-further-065906000.html), [Reuters poll](https://www.933thedrive.com/2026/11/13/bank-of-england-to-wait-until-february-to-next-raise-rates-say-economists-reuters-poll/), [Yahoo](https://finance.yahoo.com/economy/policy/articles/uk-interest-rates-fall-2026-160348987.html), [Pound Sterling Live](https://www.poundsterlinglive.com/economics/23868-bank-of-england-lombardelli-december-rate-rise-labour-market-fed), [ForexTraders](https://forextraders.com/forex-news/bank-of-englands-lombardelli-wont-rule-out-december-rate-hike/), [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/05/interest-rates-inflation-uk.html), [Reuters/Yahoo background](https://finance.yahoo.com/economy/policy/articles/central-banks-breather-though-more-142646705.html), [MPA](https://www.mpamag.com/uk/mortgage-industry/market-trends/bank-of-england-urged-to-raise-base-rate-to-5-as-inflation-set-to-miss-target-until-2030/597029)

# BoE MPC vote at the 17 December 2026 meeting: research notes

## 1. Resolution source
- The question resolves from the December 2026 Monetary Policy Summary and minutes ([BoE](https://www.bankofengland.co.uk/monetary-policy-summary-and-minutes/2026/december-2026)). That page will not exist until the decision is published on 17 Dec 2026. I did not fetch it.
- 2026-11-05 (vote taken 4 Nov): the latest decision was to raise Bank Rate from 3.75% to 4.00%. All 9 members voted to raise:
  - 25bp, 8 members: Bailey, Breeden, Dhingra, Greene, Lombardelli, Pill, Ramsden, Taylor.
  - 50bp, 1 member: Mann.
  - On this question's definition, November counts as **9 votes to raise**. ([BoE Nov 2026](https://www.bankofengland.co.uk/monetary-policy-summary-and-minutes/2026/november-2026))

## 2. Current status
- Nothing has settled the question. The meeting is scheduled for 17 Dec 2026.
- The real question is whether there is a hike at all. If there is, the count will probably be high, but Taylor and Dhingra could vote to hold. If there is no hike, the count is whatever minority votes for one: Mann almost certainly, plus possibly Pill, Greene and others.

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-11-14: In an FT interview, Chief Economist Huw Pill said the BoE will probably need to raise rates in December and again in 2027: "we have further to go." The report says he is set to vote for another 25bp rise. He called market pricing of 90bp of tightening by end-2027 "not outrageous". ([AOL/FT](https://www.aol.com/articles/boe-likely-raise-rates-further-065906000.html))
- 2026-11-13: Reuters poll, taken 11-13 Nov:
  - 64 of 65 economists expect a hold at 4.00% in December. The median expects the next hike in February, with a peak of 4.25%.
  - Seven economists see no further hikes. A few see 4.50%.
  - The poll says rate futures "almost fully" price a December hike, and that energy prices in the coming weeks will largely decide it. ([Reuters via 93.3](https://www.933thedrive.com/2026/11/13/bank-of-england-to-wait-until-february-to-next-raise-rates-say-economists-reuters-poll/))
- 2026-11-12: OIS pricing implied about a 75% chance of a 25bp December hike, according to a rate tracker as summarised in search results. I could not open the page (it returned 403). ([rateprobability](https://rateprobability.com/boe))
- 2026-11-10/11: At the BoE Watchers Conference, Lombardelli said "there is likely to be a case for a further increase in rates in the near term" and "I wouldn't rule December in or out, February in or out."
  - December pricing rose from about 13bp to about 17bp, helped by hot US CPI data.
  - Lloyds sees February as more likely than December. ([Pound Sterling Live](https://www.poundsterlinglive.com/economics/23868-bank-of-england-lombardelli-december-rate-rise-labour-market-fed), [FXStreet](https://www.fxstreet.com/news/boes-lombardelli-wouldnt-rule-it-out-rate-hike-possibility-in-december-202611100852))
- 2026-11-05: Individual guidance in the November minutes:
  - Leaning towards a near-term hike: Bailey (a further increase is warranted unless news eases inflation risks), Lombardelli (a near-term increase is likely), Pill (more near-term tightening is likely), Greene ("additional hikes will likely be required"), Mann (wanted 50bp).
  - Conditional: Breeden.
  - No direction: Ramsden.
  - Dovish: Dhingra. Taylor said "this is not the start of a hiking cycle" and the next move could be up, down or sideways.
  - The BoE warns inflation could approach 5%. ([BoE](https://www.bankofengland.co.uk/monetary-policy-summary-and-minutes/2026/november-2026), [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/05/interest-rates-inflation-uk.html))
- Background:
  - CPI was 3.5% in September, up from 3.1% in August.
  - Q3 GDP grew 0.7%.
  - Oil has been above $100 since July.
  - Retail energy bills are expected to rise about 20% in January. ([Reuters poll](https://www.933thedrive.com/2026/11/13/bank-of-england-to-wait-until-february-to-next-raise-rates-say-economists-reuters-poll/), [MPA](https://www.mpamag.com/uk/mortgage-industry/market-trends/bank-of-england-urged-to-raise-base-rate-to-5-as-inflation-set-to-miss-target-until-2030/597029))

## 4. Base rates
- This is a meeting-by-meeting vote count, not a seasonal series.
- Past hiking cycles (from my background knowledge; I did not verify these against BoE pages today):
  - Nov 2017 first hike: 7-2.
  - Dec 2021: 8-1 to raise.
  - Feb 2022: 9 of 9 voted to raise.
  - Through 2022-23, most hikes drew 1-2 votes to hold (Dhingra, Tenreyro), so 7-8 votes to raise was typical.
- When the BoE held during a cycle, hawks often dissented: in Sept 2023 the vote was 5-4 for a hold, with 4 voting to raise.
- The November 2026 vote was 9 of 9 to raise.
- The most likely dissenters on a December hike are Taylor and Dhingra, judging by their November statements.

## 5. Other forecasts
- Polymarket "Bank of England decision in December?" (prices fetched 2026-11-14): 25bp hike 72.5%, no change 26.5%, 50bp+ hike 0.15%, any cut about 0.25%. This matches the event but not the vote count.
- Polymarket, later meetings:
  - February 2027: 25bp hike 67.5%, no change 24.5%.
  - March 2027: no change 63%, 25bp hike 35%.
- Implied market pricing: about 17bp of December tightening, roughly 68%, as of 11-12 Nov ([PSL](https://www.poundsterlinglive.com/economics/23868-bank-of-england-lombardelli-december-rate-rise-labour-market-fed)). An OIS tracker shows about 75%.
- Economists disagree sharply with markets: the Reuters poll has 64 of 65 expecting a hold.
- Kalshi: the markets supplied were gold, silver and GBP/USD contracts timed to the BoE decision, not the decision itself. They are not relevant.
- I found no market on the number of votes. Manifold and Metaculus: I found nothing.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- 2026-11-18: UK October CPI. Some economists in the Reuters poll will wait for this before revising their views.
- Mid-November and mid-December: UK labour market and wage data.
- Around 2026-12-16: UK November CPI, released just before the decision. The Reuters article phrases this as "late November".
- Speeches by MPC members, especially Bailey, Taylor, Dhingra, Breeden and Ramsden, during this period.
- Oil and gas prices, which depend on how the Iran conflict develops. The Reuters poll calls energy prices the main swing factor for December.
- US Fed and ECB decisions in December. The ECB's 17 Dec meeting is priced at about 96% for a hike.
- 2026-12-17: BoE decision and minutes, with the vote published.

forecasts.reasoning:
(a) **Time left:** about 33 days. The decision and vote are published on 2026-12-17.

(b) **Latest known value:** on 2026-11-05 all 9 members voted to raise Bank Rate. Eight voted for +25bp and Mann voted for +50bp, taking Bank Rate from 3.75% to 4.00%.

(c) **If nothing changed:** a repeat of November would give 9. But the November statement said policy is "not on a pre-set path," so a straight repeat is not the default.

(d) **If the current trend continued:** hawkish signals are building. Pill signalled a vote for +25bp, Lombardelli would not rule December out, and markets moved towards a hike. That points to a 25bp rise with 7 to 8 votes. Taylor and possibly Dhingra would dissent for a hold.

(e) **Historical variation:** outcomes fall into two clusters.
- Meetings with a hike usually draw 6 to 9 hike votes.
- Holds within or around a hiking cycle usually draw 2 to 4 hike votes, as in Nov 2021, Sep, Nov and Dec 2023, and Feb 2024.
- Counts of 5 or 6 are rare.

(f) **Expert and market expectations:** the two disagree sharply.
- Polymarket gives about 72.5% for a 25bp rise.
